issue.title: Health check should report object storage problems
issue.body:
During last week's storage outage, `/api/v1/health` kept answering
`"status": "ok"` with only `db` and `queue` in `checks`, while every upload
failed. Our load balancer had no way to see it. Could the health check also try
the bucket and report it as a third check, degraded when it can't be reached?

input.title: Add object storage as a third check in the readiness endpoint
input.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The readiness handler in GET /api/v1/health only checks db and queue, so a storage outage leaves the status "ok". Add a third check for the object storage bucket, alongside db and queue, using a cheap reachability probe. Mark it "degraded" when the bucket cannot be reached, and include it in the overall status computation so the load balancer sees the problem. Keep the existing response shape.
